decisions.reason: As the core combined automation solution remained after adjacent robotic products were pruned, it likely meets strategic aspirations well enough to retain while the firm continues market learning.

Management would likely keep this more specialized shuttering robot for distinct plant configurations, though its overlap with the broader automation portfolio keeps withdrawal risk somewhat higher if results lag aspirations.

Because this newly launched multi-model machine fits the firm's established integrated equipment business, organizational slack and the need for customer feedback would support keeping it on the market for now.

This production analysis software is close to the firm's core offering and strengthens lifecycle support, so a German machinery firm with in-house R&D would usually refine it rather than drop it unless performance clearly falls below aspirations.
